children.name: Mystropetalon thomii Harv.
children.description: A non-photosynthetic root-parasitic flowering plant of the Balanophoraceae (sometimes segregated as Mystropetalaceae), the only species of its genus. Endemic to South Africa's southwestern Cape, it is a terrestrial parasite of woody hosts in the fynbos biome. SANBI Red List: Least Concern with a stable population.

children.name: Dactylanthus taylorii Hook.fil.
children.description: Dactylanthus taylorii, commonly known in English as wood rose and in Māori as ("flower of the underworld"), is a fully parasitic flowering plant, the only one endemic to New Zealand.

children.name: Hachettea austrocaledonica Baill.
children.description: A chlorophyll-less parasitic flowering plant of the Balanophoraceae (sometimes placed in Mystropetalaceae), the only species of the monotypic genus Hachettea. It is a root parasite endemic to New Caledonia, and its closest relative is Dactylanthus of New Zealand.
